Slop PDF guide

Getting started with Slop PDF

Slop PDF edits PDFs in your browser. You open a file, work on its pages, and download a new PDF. The file never leaves your device.

Open Slop PDF

Watch the Slop PDF tutorial: a free PDF editor in the browser
On YouTube, about one minute.

Open a PDF

All pages appear as thumbnails in the Organize view. Each file gets its own colour dot, so you can see where a page came from. The S, M and L buttons and the slider above the pages change the thumbnail size.

  1. Drop one or more PDFs on the page. Pictures (PNG, JPEG, WebP) work too: each one becomes a page.
  2. Or choose Open PDFs or images… in the File menu (Ctrl+O, or Cmd+O on a Mac).
  3. To look around first, click Try a sample.

The tool rail

The rail on the left holds the tools: Organize, Edit page, Sign, Redact, Page numbers, Watermark, Comments, Forms, Compress, Convert, OCR, Split and Metadata.

Click a tool and its settings open in the panel on the right.

Add text, shapes and highlights

Annotations are flattened into the page when you download. Clear page annotations in the panel removes all of them from the page you are on.

  1. Double-click a page, or click Edit page in the rail, to open the page view.
  2. Pick a tool in the panel or in the bar above the page. Text is T, Draw is P, Highlighter is H, Rectangle is R and Arrow is A.
  3. Click the page to place text, or drag to draw a shape.
  4. Press V for Select & move. Click an annotation to select it, drag it to move it, and use its handles to resize it. Double-click text to edit it.
  5. Press Escape to go back to all the pages.

Tip: Edit text in place (Ctrl+E) in the Edit menu lets you change the PDF's own text, not just add new text.

Download the PDF

Undo (Ctrl+Z) and Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z) work for every change until you close the file.

  1. Type a file name in the name box at the top, if you want a different one.
  2. Click Download. Slop PDF builds the new file, checks it, and saves it to your device.

Keyboard shortcuts

KeysWhat it does
Ctrl+OOpen PDFs or images
Ctrl+SSave (to Slop Drive, or download)
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+ZUndo / redo
Ctrl+FFind in document
Ctrl+KSearch commands
EnterOpen the page view
EscapeBack to all pages
V, T, P, HSelect, Text, Draw, Highlighter (page view)
PageDown / PageUpNext / previous page
